parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: Specifies the regular expression pattern against which the Username attribute in the Access-Request is matched to determine the corresponding Realm block. This is used to determine the {{param|Server}} to which the Access-Request should be forwarded. The format is implementation specific.

parameters.name: Server
parameters.description: Specifies the server to which requests for this realm should be forwarded. If no server is configured, the RadSecProxy service will deny all Access-Requests for this realm.

parameters.name: AccountingServer
parameters.description: Specifies the accounting Server. If no accounting Server is configured, the RadSecProxy service will silently ignore all Accounting-Requests for this realm unless {{param|AccountingResponse}} is set to {{true}}.

parameters.name: AccountingResponse
parameters.description: Enable sending Accounting-Response instead of ignoring Accounting-Requests when no accounting servers are configured.

object.description: Realm block configuration of the RadSecProxy service as defined in {{bibref|RFC6614|Appendix B}}.
